_comment: Envelope matrices for benchmark.py's --envelope-probe mode. Each table key maps to a list of (label, bbox) probes — bbox is [minlon, minlat, maxlon, maxlat]. The probe runs SELECT COUNT(*) with the 4-conjunct bbox-overlap form against spatial_iceberg vs iceberg, isolating the Z2-overlay value-add at multiple selectivities. Selectivity percentages in labels are rough observations from representative runs.
